remarks: Set in the premier Newfield neighborhood near local amenities & the Sterling Farms Golf Course, this ranch-style home offers comfortable living on a private 1 acre plus setting. The main level features a large living room with a wood burning fireplace that opens seamlessly to the dining room, creating an inviting layout for everyday living & entertaining. The spacious kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, & direct access to the private patio and backyard. The primary bedroom suite includes generous closet space & a full bathroom, while two additional bedrooms and another full bathroom complete the main level. The lower level features a finished living area with a full bathroom, offering flexible use as a guest space, potential bedroom, office, rec room, or possible in-law setup, with additional unfinished space offering future expansion potential. Additional highlights include a 2-car garage, elevator, generous outdoor space, & a highly convenient Newfield location.
